# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first one-button endless runner named Crownfrost Marine: Orbital Oath. Preserve the source loop exactly: the player remains fixed near the left of the screen, tap or Space jumps only when grounded, gravity pulls the player back to the runway, obstacles and collectibles spawn from the right and move left, collectibles increment score by one and slightly increase speed, obstacle collision ends the run, and restart resets the state.

Build the presentation as a royal frozen space-marine fantasy: a crowned icy armored marine runs across an orbital palace runway, collects glowing star-oath crests, and avoids jagged cryo obelisks. Use procedural canvas art for the starfield, ringed planet, ice palace spires, runway, marine, hazards, rewards, and particles. Use royal gold accents, icy cyan/blue gradients, Cinzel title styling, Orbitron HUD styling, concise mobile HUD copy, and snow-biome audio accents from the approved catalog.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first one-button endless runner / jumper
- objective: survive side-scrolling travel, leap over ground obstacles, collect airborne items, and raise the score by one per collectible
- input model: pointer/tap anywhere on the playfield or Space key; buttons use normal click/tap paths
- core loop: start game, player runs at fixed x, tap/Space jumps only when grounded, gravity returns the player to ground, obstacles and collectibles spawn from the right and move left, collectible collision increments score and speed, obstacle collision triggers game over and restart
- fail/friction state: collision with a ground obstacle ends the run; missed collectibles simply leave the screen

## Protected Mechanics
- one-tap/Space grounded jump with the original force and gravity defaults
- endless runner horizontal spawn/move-left loop
- obstacle contact failure using the same forgiving AABB padding concept
- collectible contact scoring, score HUD update, particles, and slight speed increase per collection
- start, game-over, and restart state flow

## Remix Trajectory
The rebuilt game reframes the dog snack dash as Crownfrost Marine: Orbital Oath, a royal frozen-space runner where a crowned space marine bounds across an ice orbital palace, collects glowing star-oath crests, and avoids rogue cryo obelisks. The loop remains mechanically faithful while the scene, HUD nouns, focal silhouette, background, feedback, typography, and audio mood are rebuilt.
